scope: SO and RE unresolved source/manual or boundary behavior

probes.question: Confirm official executable accepts SWPOINT only with ALPHA and records the expected six-parameter signature.
probes.result: The six-parameter SWPOINT form completed successfully with ALPHA; the same form without ALPHA was rejected with SO E198 from SRCSIZ.

probes.question: Confirm the one- and two-barrier VBARRIER field forms with valid in-range parameters.
probes.result: Both one-barrier and two-barrier forms completed successfully for an ALPHA/FLAT RLINEXT source when HT, WT, LAI, and LM were inside source-enforced ranges.

probes.question: Confirm VBARRIER range-boundary inclusivity for E371-E374 and same-side W375 barrier selection behavior.
probes.result: Both barrier positions accept HT 2.0..10.0 m, WT 2.5..13.0 m, LAI 4.0..10.92, and LM/LAD 0.55..3.75 inclusively. Immediate below/above values are rejected with E371-E374. For unequal same-side absolute DCL values, W375 identifies and retains the nearer barrier while zeroing the farther barrier. Equal-distance same-side barriers produce no W375 at input, retain both debug records, and later emit W620; v26135 runtime selects barrier 2 on the equality tie because its comparison changes the default only when barrier 1 is strictly closer.
probes.boundary: The equal-distance barrier-2 tie result is exact v26135 source behavior, not a general physical recommendation; future versions must remain separately versioned.

probes.question: Confirm trailing PLATFORM fields are accepted/ignored or rejected; source only checks minimum count.
Confirm duplicate global/sector profile precedence and hourly/static conflict behavior.
Confirm omitted NetID continuation forms preserve the active grid block exactly.
Confirm warning-versus-ignore behavior for terrain/flag fields supplied under inactive options.
